name: Eric Ohlsen
office: City of Palmdale, Member of the City Council, 4th District

items.text: Eric Ohlsen is the mayor of Palmdale and represents District 4 on the Palmdale City Council. He was elected in 2022 and served in the U.S. Coast Guard. He founded the Community Coalition of the Antelope Valley, which runs desert cleanups and rural broadband work. In January 2026 the council expanded Palmdale's Aerospace Incentive Program to offer up to $500,000 for construction and $125,000 for leases. Ohlsen said the program aims to attract aerospace suppliers and create skilled jobs. In June 2026 a code enforcement illegal dumping investigation uncovered over 800 pounds of methamphetamine. Ohlsen said he created the Community Preservation Program and that giving code enforcement the right focus protects residents' quality of life.
